title: Join us for our upcoming Knowledge Portal Webinar Thursday, April 9, 2026!
bodyHtml:
Be among the first to explore what’s new in the Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal (CMDKP). Join us for our upcoming Knowledge Portal Webinar:

? Enabling Discovery: Unveiling New Data, Features, and Tools in CMDKP
? Thursday, April 9, 2026
⏰ 12:00–1:00 PM ET

This session offers an exclusive first look at the latest production release designed to accelerate discovery and empower your research.

What you’ll learn:
? A walkthrough of new data, features, and tools
⚙️ Practical tips on how to get the most out of the latest updates
? Insider insights into what we built and why it matters
? A chance to ask questions live and connect with the team

Whether you’re a current user or new to CMDKP, this webinar will help you unlock the full potential of the platform.

? Register: https://broadinstitute.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN__dgDoIUZSVyPwKvZ3Xx7mQ
